description: Search stored memories by semantic similarity. Returns ranked results with relevance scores. Supports filtering by tags, date range, tier, and memory type.

after.description: ISO timestamp — only return memories created after this time

before.description: ISO timestamp — only return memories created before this time

full_content.description: Reassemble chunked memories into full content (default: false). Use for poems, essays, or content that must be returned whole.

tags.description: Filter by tags (AND logic — memory must have all specified tags)

name: velixar_search
